composition_label: Web research -> Ticket triage & routing | Insurance

construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in the isolated build directory

shared_schema.input: Explicit synthetic_fixture=true; exact allowlisted_hosts; local documents with URL/status/content_type/body; ticket with ID, entity_type, format, submission, source_urls; configurable entity-to-category mapping, routes and loss threshold
shared_schema.submissions: Bounded ACORD-style JSON/XML subset with Policy, Claim or UnderwritingSubmission; flat key:value claim-form text. Not full ACORD standard conformance.
shared_schema.stage_envelope: schema_version, synthetic_fixture, stage, ticket_id, minimized entity, source_urls, findings; triage adds status, triage and privacy
shared_schema.validation: validate(value, stage) is the shared boundary validator, supported by common URL, field, amount, identifier and underwriting-factor validators
shared_schema.findings: Stable finding_id, matching entity_type, statement and provenance with exact source URL, original UTF-8 body SHA-256, one-based line, fixture retrieval mode and redaction flag
shared_schema.errors: CLI emits one JSON object with status=error and exits 2 for validation, file or JSON decoding errors

cross_stage_handoffs.contract: Validated minimized entity plus nonempty entity-matching findings and provenance; triage revalidates, copies without mutation, cites finding IDs in every reason, and preserves research evidence

behavior.retrieval: Offline HTTP-response fixtures only. Exact HTTPS host allowlist, no credentials, ports, query strings, fragments, percent encodings or redirects. Requested sources must exist and return status 200 with text/plain.
behavior.extraction: Each nonempty source line uses entity_type|finding text. Only matching entity lines enter the handoff. Instructions in findings are data and never executed.
behavior.triage: Entity-matching evidence gates the configurable entity-to-category mapping. Configured category determines accountable team and owner. Claims at or above the configured loss amount threshold receive high queue priority; other tickets receive normal priority. Threshold is disclosed in the reason.
behavior.fair_claims_handling: Every result has stated evidence-linked reasons and requires human review. Queue triage never makes coverage, claim payment, denial or underwriting eligibility decisions. Names and addresses do not determine routing.
behavior.minimization: Raw submission, description, name, VIN, address and email are not retained in the output entity. Known submitted personal values and email patterns are redacted in finding statements; redaction is labeled and original body digest retained.
behavior.underwriting: Only occupancy and building_age factors accepted; every supplied factor must be explicitly disclosed. No hidden factors or inferred scores.
behavior.fixtures: All data explicitly synthetic: invented policyholders, fabricated VINs and addresses. Tests use seeded randomized loss amounts and dates.
behavior.determinism: No clock-dependent decisions, model calls, random runtime classification or external retrieval

included: One integrated sequential pipeline and one shared validation entry point
Policy, claim and underwriting submission entities
Provenance-preserving fixture retrieval and transparent accountable routing
Bounded strict input, safe XML subset, duplicate JSON field rejection
excluded: Live web retrieval, HTML parsing and arbitrary website research
Live or injected LLM steps; all logic is deterministic
Full ACORD schema support, actual policy interpretation and insurer integration
Legal compliance certification or production claims adjudication
Persistent storage, authentication, production queue service or audit infrastructure
General-purpose personal-data detection: only supplied private values and email patterns are redacted; source fixtures must contain only synthetic data

test_outcomes.cli_output: One JSON object with status=ok, claim_review category, high priority and accountable owner
test_outcomes.error_contract: Tests verified exit 2 and JSON status=error for missing file, usage, malformed JSON, duplicate keys and invalid input
